faq.q: How do I install GTA: San Andreas on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for GTA: San Andreas and check the developer is Rockstar Games before tapping the price button. It needs Android 9 or newer. It costs $6.99 on Google Play, and once bought it's tied to your Google account, so you can reinstall it on any phone for free. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Rockstar Games and may be altered, so the safest way to play GTA: San Andreas is the official listing.

faq.q: How much is GTA: San Andreas on Android?
faq.a: GTA: San Andreas costs $6.99 on Google Play in the US, as a one-time purchase. There are no ads. Prices vary by country, and the game is sometimes discounted in Google Play sales.

faq.q: Is GTA: San Andreas on Android the full game?
faq.a: Yes. The Google Play version contains the full story of the original game, with all of San Andreas: Los Santos, San Fierro, Las Venturas and the countryside, adapted with touch controls and improved graphics.

faq.q: Can I use a controller with GTA: San Andreas on Android?
faq.a: Yes. The Android version supports many Bluetooth controllers, which many players find easier than touch controls for driving and aiming.

faq.a: Netflix members can play GTA: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition, a remastered version, through Netflix Games at no extra cost while they're subscribed. The Rockstar version on Google Play is a separate one-time purchase.
